judgement.reason: Shaarli is a database-free bookmarking service whose core data (bookmarks, config) lives only in a local data directory, which Deployz's stateless containers cannot persist.

evidence.quote: The personal, minimalist, super fast, database-free, bookmarking service.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: VOLUME /var/www/shaarli/data (Dockerfile), volume shaarli-data:/var/www/shaarli/data (docker-compose.yml shaarli)
reviews.reason: Shaarli is a database-free bookmarking service that keeps its bookmarks and configuration in /var/www/shaarli/data, and no shown setting moves that data to a managed database or S3, so it would be lost on every restart.
